nodes.name: AAO-templated electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Sequential electrodeposition of Fe nanowires then Cu nanowires into AAO membrane on Ag conductive paste coated electrode, followed by heat treatment after removing alumina membrane.
nodes.source_text: Kang et al. successfully prepared heterostructured Fe2O3-Cu2O nanowire arrays using anodic aluminum oxide (AAO) as the template by sequential electrodeposition... heat-treated electrode after removing the alumina membrane.

nodes.name: PS-template inverse opal
nodes.procedure: Colloidal crystal PS thin film grown on FTO coated glass, voids filled with SnO2 nanoparticles by atomic layer deposition (ALD) cycles, PS template removed by calcination in air to yield 3D ordered macroporous SnO2 film (inverse opal), then BiVO4 deposited as conformal layer by spin coating.
nodes.source_text: Kim and co-workers reported the synthesis of 3D BiVO4/SnO2 heterojunctions using a PS-template method... BiVO4 was deposited as a conformal layer on the porous 3D SnO2 skeleton by spin coating.

nodes.name: PS-template hematite NR@NB
nodes.procedure: Single layer PS colloid template method combined with nanosphere lithography and hydrothermal growth of hematite to fabricate 3D Fe2O3 nanorod@nanobowl arrays.
nodes.source_text: Tang et al. fabricated 3D hematite nanorod@nanobowl arrays (NR@NB) via a single layer PS colloid template method combined with nanosphere lithography and hydrothermal growth of hematite.

nodes.name: CB-template SnO2/CdS
nodes.procedure: CB films directly grown on FTO through flame combustion of ethanol and toluene, serving as template to direct SnO2 deposition by atomic layer deposition (ALD) method. Then CB template selectively removed by calcination, after which CdS shell-layer coated onto 3D SnO2 scaffold using chemical bath deposition (CBD) method.
nodes.source_text: Hu et al. to synthesize 3D nanoporous SnO2/CdS heterojunctions. Specifically, CB films were directly grown on FTO through the flame combustion of ethanol and toluene... SnO2 deposition by ALD... CB template selectively removed by calcination... CdS shell-layer coated using CBD.

nodes.name: ZnO template nanotube
nodes.procedure: ZnO nanorod arrays prepared on FTO substrates, subsequently used as sacrificial templates to construct core-shell Sb-SnO2@Fe2O3 nanotube heterojunctions.
nodes.source_text: Feng et al. prepared ZnO nanorod arrays on FTO substrates, which were subsequently used as sacrificial templates to construct core-shell Sb-SnO2@Fe2O3 nanotube heterojunctions.

nodes.name: Two-step hydrothermal TiO2@Cu2O
nodes.procedure: First, TiO2 NWA grown on FTO substrate by hydrothermal reaction of titanium n-butoxide and HCl, followed by thermal treatment. Next, Cu2O shells coated on TiO2 nanowires through second hydrothermal synthesis in mixed solution of PEI and Cu(NO3)2.
nodes.source_text: Yuan et al. fabricated core-shell TiO2@Cu2O nanowire arrays (NWA) on FTO glass via a two-step hydrothermal strategy... hydrothermal reaction of titanium n-butoxide and HCl... second hydrothermal synthesis in PEI and Cu(NO3)2.

nodes.name: Multi-step WO3 heterojunction
nodes.procedure: WO3 nanoplate arrays synthesized on FTO by hydrothermal growth, serving as 2D core scaffold for subsequent deposition of conformal BiVO4 and Co-Pi coatings.
nodes.source_text: Zhang et al. synthesized WO3 nanoplate arrays on FTO by hydrothermal growth... served as 2D core scaffold for subsequent deposition of conformal BiVO4 and Co-Pi coatings.
